description: On every Skill-tool invocation, touches ~/.cache/agent-tools/skills-invoked/<session-id>/<skill-name> (mtime = invocation time; session-scoped by CC's own session id so one session can't satisfy another concurrent session's check, falling back to the pre-session-scoping global path when no valid session id is on the event) — the freshness marker skills-read-gate's pre-bash check reads. This is the wrapper skills-read-gate's own README calls for; without it that gate's marker directory is never written and the gate can never leave its WARN-forever tier. Sanitizes the skill name against path traversal (rejects '..'/absolute/oversized/NUL values; a legitimate directory-scoped skill name containing '/' is allowed to nest) and the session id (rejected as a single flat segment on any '/'). Never blocks: on_error=open and every code path emits allow, because a marker-write hiccup must not stop a skill from being invoked.
